items.title: A termwise split sequence of complexes of complexes gives a connecting morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a termwise split sequence of complexes of complexes the family of morphisms obtained by projecting the differential of the middle term along the splitting defines a morphism of complexes from the third term to the shift of the first (statement lines 3736-3754). The proof is a complete argument: the displayed identity relating the two maps of the sequence, the projection and the splitting is used first to rewrite the projection term (proof lines 3756-3760), and then once more after applying the differential of the first complex, which shows that the constructed family commutes with the differentials and hence is a morphism of complexes (proof lines 3760-3763). The non-formal content is the displayed computation with the two identities. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
